name: Cosmic Psycho
source:
Kazuyuki is just an ordinary Japanese high-school student... or so he was before he saw a strange dream. In that dream, a girl was calling him from the outer space, imploring him to help her... The next day, Kazuyuki receives a strange phone call, after which he finds himself on board of a space ship! The girl from his dream appears and introduces herself: she is Marin, one of the members of a special squad that fights mysterious alien beings known as EX. Apparently, her message through time went to the wrong recipient, and now Kazuyuki is "stuck" in the end of the twenty-third century, reluctantly helping the beautiful ladies of the assault team to fight aliens - and perhaps engage in other, more pleasant activities.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cosmic-psycho]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
和之本来只是个普通的日本高中生……至少在做那个怪梦以前是如此。梦里，一名少女从遥远的外太空呼唤他，恳求他出手相救……翌日，和之接到一通诡异电话，随后竟发现自己已经身处宇宙飞船之中！梦中的少女玛琳出现在他面前，自称是特殊作战部队的一员，负责对抗被称作EX的神秘外星生命。她跨越时空传出的讯息似乎找错了对象，和之也因此被困在23世纪末，不情不愿地协助突击队的美女们迎战外星人——当然，他们或许还会一起从事一些更令人愉快的活动。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/cosmic-psycho]MobyGames[/url]]
